title: Simplify color spectrum and proportional corner system for table rows
creator: Ava Chen
description: Goal: Reduce visual noise in dense data tables by introducing a simplified color contour (a constrained palette for row backgrounds, separators, and focus states) and a proportional corner/radius system that scales predictably with row height. This ticket covers token definitions, updated component references, a migration plan for existing tables, and accessibility checks for contrast and focus outlines. Deliverables: 1) token spec for color.contour.* and radius.row-* variants, 2) updated table and row component tokens and examples, 3) Figma kit with responsive token variants, 4) migration notes and PR checklist for engineering. Constraints: must preserve existing high-contrast modes, keep token surface count <= 6 for rows, and ensure vertical rhythm remains consistent across density modes.
acceptance_criteria: Tokens defined: color.contour.[0-5], color.contour-accent.[0-2], radius.row.[xs|sm|md|lg] with numeric rem values
Updated Table component references the new tokens and renders without layout shifts at three density breakpoints
Contrast ratios meet WCAG 2.1 AA for text-on-row-background in default and high-contrast modes
Figma kit and token export (tokens.json) uploaded to design drive and linked in the ticket
Migration guide with automated codemod suggestions added to the engineering PR description
comments: 2026-02-25 - Ava Chen: Initial ticket created after Q1 design audit. Observed inconsistent corner radii across row heights and too many near-duplicate surface colors in tables. Proposed a constrained contour spectrum with fewer stops and a proportional corner scale tied to row height tokens.

2026-03-01 - Marco Alvarez: Began exploration of radius mapping. Prototype: radius.row.xs = 4px for 32px rows, sm = 6px for 40px rows, md = 8px for 56px rows. Shared Figma file: https://figma.com/file/REDWOOD-rows/contour-prototype (internal).

2026-03-04 - Accessibility review (Priya Shah): Checked contrast on prototype. color.contour.1 on text failed AA at 14px; recommend raising contrast for .1 or bumping text weight. Added to acceptance criteria.
2026-03-07 - Design critique (team): Agreed to keep contour stops to 5 (0-4) + accent set. Decided to collapse subtle separator color into contour. Action: update tokens and produce token export.

2026-03-09 - Marco Alvarez: Draft PR opened for component updates: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ui/pull/1042. PR includes storybook stories for three densities and a migration checklist. Marked as Draft while token names stabilize.

2026-03-11 - Product (Lina Gomez): Confirmed product acceptance: behavior for focus and selection states must be deterministic across Dedicated and Private deployments (no runtime theme differences). Added label 'tokens' and requested release gating in console-2026.03.

2026-03-12 - Ava Chen: Uploaded final token spec to Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/REDWOOD/tokens/contour-2026-03-12 and attached a short migration playbook. Noted two follow-ups: (1) add unit tests for token mapping in ENG-4123, (2) schedule a short rollout sync with platform engineering.
2026-03-12 - Marco Alvarez: Updated PR with token names per spec, added codemod examples in PR description (search-and-replace snippets). Requesting design review + eng readiness checklist.

2026-03-12 - Review note (Bethany Ortiz, Design Ops): Please ensure tokens.json includes metadata fields: token.type, token.usage, and token.fallback for older themes. We'll need these for the token migration tooling.
